packageRules.description: Enable indirect (transitive) Go module updates, off by default in Renovate

Never propose major bumps of indirect Go modules: a Go major is a distinct module path, so the bump rewrites a require line the module graph still needs and go mod tidy reverts it. Must stay after the enable rule above; later matching rules win. Do not fold this into that rule as matchUpdateTypes, which disables indirect updates entirely because the enable decision runs before updateType is known.
Low-risk: Go module minor and patch
Low-risk: GitHub Actions minor and patch
